story_description: Provide a comprehensive template gallery with production-ready hook recipes that users can deploy with one click, covering security, testing, context, notifications, and workflow patterns.
task: T008: Populate Template Gallery with Production Hook Recipes
task_description: Expand the HookTemplates module from 5 basic templates to 17+ production-ready recipes sourced from the Claude Code community, covering multi-stage validation, MCP deletion protection, quality checks, task completion verification, session management, and notification logging.
atom: A001: Add 17 Production Hook Recipes to Template Gallery
atom_description: Extend HookTemplates with 12 additional templates: fileWriteValidation, bashCommandSafety, multiStageValidation, mcpDeletionProtection, conditionalEnvironment, fileWriteQualityCheck, editAnalysisFeedback, taskCompletionVerification, buildTestEnforcement, contextTranscriptReview, projectContextLoader, oneTimeInitialization, sessionResumeRestoration, contextBackup, notificationLogger, permissionAutoApproval, and userPromptSecurityGuidance. Each template includes production-tested content from Claude Code community best practices.
problem_statement: The current 5 templates provide basic coverage but miss critical patterns discovered by the Claude Code community: multi-stage validation combining fast deterministic checks with LLM analysis, MCP tool protection, quality enforcement with linters, and comprehensive session lifecycle management. Without these recipes, users must reverse-engineer complex patterns from documentation.
scope_in: Add fileWriteValidation template (PreToolUse, Write|Edit, prompt) blocking /etc, system dirs, .env, credentials, path traversal
Add bashCommandSafety template (PreToolUse, Bash, prompt) analyzing for destructive ops, privilege escalation, network abuse
Add multiStageValidation template (PreToolUse, Bash, hybrid) combining quick-check.sh with LLM deep analysis
Add mcpDeletionProtection template (PreToolUse, mcp__.*__delete.*, prompt) requiring deletion confirmation
Add conditionalEnvironment template (PreToolUse, *, command) skipping validation outside CI
Add fileWriteQualityCheck template (PostToolUse, Write|Edit, command) running linters on modified files
Add editAnalysisFeedback template (PostToolUse, Edit, prompt) analyzing for syntax errors, security vulns, breaking changes
Add taskCompletionVerification template (Stop, *, prompt) verifying tests run, build succeeded, questions answered
Add buildTestEnforcement template (Stop, *, prompt) checking if code modified requires build verification
Add contextTranscriptReview template (Stop, *, prompt) reviewing full transcript for test/build completion
Add projectContextLoader template (SessionStart, *, command) auto-detecting project type and exporting env vars
Add oneTimeInitialization template (SessionStart, startup, command) with once:true for first-run setup
Add sessionResumeRestoration template (SessionStart, resume, command) restoring state on session resume
Add contextBackup template (PreCompact, auto, command) backing up context before compaction
Add notificationLogger template (Notification, *, command) logging all notifications for audit trails
Add permissionAutoApproval template (PermissionRequest, Bash, prompt) contextual auto-approval evaluation
Add userPromptSecurityGuidance template (UserPromptSubmit, *, prompt) injecting security warnings when discussing auth/permissions
Update HookTemplates.all to include all 17 templates
Add new TemplateCategory cases: multiStage, mcp, quality, lifecycle, audit, permissions to categorize expanded templates
Update templates(for:) to filter by new categories
scope_out: Remote template fetching or registry sync
assumptions: T005 HookTemplates module exists with Template struct and TemplateCategory enum
HookType enum supports prompt, command, and hybrid cases
Claude Code hook output schema is stable across the recipes
Scripts reference CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT environment variable for portability
jq is available on user systems for JSON processing in command hooks
constraints: Must not break existing T005 templates or API surface
All new templates must conform to existing Template struct schema
Command templates must output valid JSON matching hook output schema
Prompt templates must return valid decision keywords (allow/deny/ask/approve/block)
All bash scripts must use set -euo pipefail for safety
Templates must be portable across macOS and Linux
functional_requirements: fileWriteValidation returns deny with reason when path contains /etc, /System, .env, credentials, or .. traversal patterns
bashCommandSafety returns deny when command contains rm -rf /, chmod 777, curl|bash, sudo without justification
multiStageValidation runs quick-check.sh (5s timeout) first, then LLM analysis (15s timeout) for comprehensive review
mcpDeletionProtection returns ask when any mcp__*__delete* tool is invoked, requiring explicit confirmation
conditionalEnvironment returns allow immediately when CI environment variable is not set
fileWriteQualityCheck runs eslint for .js/.ts files, swiftlint for .swift, ruff for .py on modified files
editAnalysisFeedback returns systemMessage with analysis of potential syntax errors, security issues, or breaking changes
taskCompletionVerification returns block if tests not run or build not executed after code changes
buildTestEnforcement inspects tool history for Write/Edit usage and requires build verification if present
contextTranscriptReview examines full conversation transcript to verify all quality gates were met
projectContextLoader detects package.json, Cargo.toml, Package.swift to set PROJECT_TYPE env var
oneTimeInitialization runs first-run-setup.sh only once per session using once:true option
sessionResumeRestoration runs restore-state.sh when session type is resume to reload previous context
contextBackup runs backup-context.sh before automatic compaction to preserve important context
notificationLogger appends notification JSON to audit log file for compliance and debugging
permissionAutoApproval evaluates command context and returns allow for safe operations, ask for risky ones
userPromptSecurityGuidance returns systemMessage with security warnings when prompt mentions auth, API keys, or permissions

failure_modes: Missing jq binary causes command templates to fail; mitigation: check jq availability and provide fallback

quick-check.sh missing causes multiStageValidation to fail first stage; mitigation: proceed to LLM analysis only
Backup directory not writable causes contextBackup to fail; mitigation: log warning and continue without backup

risk_register.fallback_plan: If expanded templates cause issues, remove them from HookTemplates.all while keeping T005 baseline; Template Gallery continues working with 5 templates
